about: Captured 2026-11-17 in the owner's Chrome from homedepot.com product pages (fetch('/p/<id>') inside a homedepot.com tab, no SerpApi). The key of the pricing object in base-catalog-<itemId> and its scalar fields.
priceBlock: Both pages: one element matching [data-component^="price:Price"] (data-component="price:Price:v6.41.0") holding the price, was-price and savings.
